subject: Visiting Tokyo around the end of march - Any R-related things going on?

messages.author: 66d02f4f7e054c30
messages.subject: Visiting Tokyo around the end of march - Any R-related things going on?
parts:
Dear Friends,

I will visit japan on holiday for the first time this year. I come from Hamburg Germany, where I live and work and sometimes attend R-Meetups (https://github.com/rusershamburg).
I am very excited to visit Japan and Tokyo and would like to learn about the japanese way of doing statistics (and maybe visit the place where the AIC was postulated). I will be in your city for a couple of days around the end of march.
Please get in touch, if you would be interested in meeting up and exchanging ideas.

Kind regards and all the best for now
Henning

(henningsway.github.io)

Hello Henning,

I am Atsushi and Japan.R organizer.
Japan.R is the largest R-Meetups in Japan. Web site is here. ( http://japanr.net ) Sorry, Japanese only. 

Welcome to Japan and R user group. We would like to meet you in Tokyo.
In the past, we hold R-Meetups with only English sessions. ( https://atnd.org/events/49191 )
If we can adjust the schedule for you, we will held meetup event. Or I want to eat dinner.
Could you tell me plans in Tokyo?

Thank you.
Atsushi Hayakawa
